scientific_integrity: Analytical statements reconstructed from the environmental equations; exact cancellation, sharp pointwise envelope and an explicit resonant equilibrium continuum are proved; finite computations provide only corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The bound is for distance to a union of boundary faces, not necessarily convergence to one face.
The nonresonant recurrence obstruction applies only to states with all three environment qualities strictly interior.
Resonance is necessary for interior recurrence but not sufficient for it under arbitrary payoff matrices.
The source uses equal-sized communities and identical time scales for the three logistic environmental responses.
No independent originality or proof validation has been performed.
title: Harmonic-feedback resonance and exponential environmental escape in a two-community game
